title.narrative: Programa de Apoyo a las Exportaciones de la Economa del Conocimiento
Support Program for Knowledge Economy Exports

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es contribuir al aumento de las exportaciones de los sectores de la Economa del Conocimiento (EDC) a travs de la provisin de capital humano especializado, del desarrollo y adopcin de tecnologas basadas enInteligencia Artificial (IA) y de la promocin de su insercin internacional.Los objetivos especficos son: (i) fortalecer la formacin de capital humano requerido por los sectores de la EDC; (ii) aumentar la colaboracin entre el sistema cientfico tecnolgico y el sector productivo en tecnologas basadas enInteligencia Artificial (IA); y (iii) contribuir a la internacionalizacin de las empresas de los sectores de la EDC.

The objective of the program is to contribute to the increase in exports of the Knowledge Economy sectors(EDC) through the provision of specialized human capital, the development and adoption of technologies based onArtificial Intelligence (AI) and the promotion of its international insertion.. The specific objectives are: (i) strengthen the formation of human capital required by the EDC sectors; (ii) increase collaboration between the technological scientific system and the productive sector in technologies based on Artificial Intelligence (AI); and (iii) contribute to the internationalization of companies in the EDC sectors.
Commitment in 2023-06-09
Disbursement in second quarter of 2025
